criterion.criterion_text: A formal theorem has no empirical QBP-01 authority without an independently verified formal-to-empirical correspondence and the preregistered measurement receipts.
Computational spectrum replication does not establish a classical optical phenotype; the spectrum-to-optical correspondence and all QBP-01 empirical receipts must be independently verified.
Classical optical responsiveness does not establish nonclassical photon statistics; QBP-02 requires its own calibrated quantum-optical witness chain.
Q6 is necessary but not sufficient for a quantum biological information channel; channel-specific biological linkage must be independently established.
Finite source calculus cannot promote to global Weil positivity without an explicit operator identity, justified finite-to-global passage, and global sign transfer.
Integrity and replay evidence bind what was recorded; they do not establish biological correctness or clinical validity without separate clinical validation receipts.

A deterministic public yeast null-precursor analysis does not establish the GBA1/SPNS1 optical bridge, Parkinson biomarker status, or a quantum claim; the full biological optical bridge requires its own direct measurements and replication.
Encoding equality and deterministic SDK replay do not authenticate caller-supplied snapshots, approvals, capability maps, policy, generation, or revocation state.

Authentication may permit planning over authenticated data, but activation still requires the live single-authority transaction, freshness/capability rechecks, operator authorization, and a dispatch receipt.

The historical union of individually legitimate reconciliation receipts is provenance only and cannot decide current globalizability; the current epoch/time/context and active receipt nerve must be rebuilt and verified.
Pairwise edges do not create a joint three-party receipt, and local cocycle consistency does not by itself establish a global section; joint topology and a global witness must be carried explicitly.
Prepared Lean source is not a kernel theorem until the pinned candidate bytes are compiled under the declared toolchain and the theorem/axiom surface is audited.

A sealed gold set and scorer establish evaluation infrastructure, not system efficacy; matched control/AEGIS runs, provenance checks, scoring and independent replay are required before a false-promotion reduction claim.

A defect finding at one pinned main snapshot cannot establish the current implementation state; current strict RFC 8785 conformance requires a fresh exact-source replay of the normative boundary and dependent identity transition.
A typed architecture DAG and verified witnesses produce candidates only; action authority remains a separate operator-governed admission transition and is never automatic.

Numerically verified 1BNA coordinate proxies do not establish how the 6-site GTG Hamiltonian or gamma=0.1 parameters were derived. The uploaded GTG replay explicitly excludes parameter regeneration and physical validation.

A numerically accurate replay of archived arrays does not establish current repository provenance. The declared source commit b0a840... still returns no commit on a fresh GitHub read, so source identity must remain separate from replay correctness.

Package integrity, optimized replay and 63 internal checks establish replay behavior only. The receipt itself records formal kernel execution=false, experimental gate evaluation=false, repository requests=false, admission not established, and authority_effect=NONE.
A successful 8907-job upstream FormalConjectures build cannot verify a separately uploaded Lean file unless that exact candidate is in the build graph and its own kernel/axiom evidence is captured.

40/40 local tests under normal/-O/-OO, a source-slice apply replay, and 5/5 detected mutations do not establish deployed-service behavior or any external dispatch effect. The independent receipt records live_dispatch=false, remote_writes=0 and authority_effect=NONE.

Automaton-2 and Trusted Cognitive Admission at historical exact head dcbd6a31 establish the governed manifest transition only. The same package's Integration Ledger reports 0 WIRED and explicitly leaves execution unverified; cognitive admission is not runtime integration or production authority.
